Method of Attack: Five bursts of malicious updates switching clean and malicious versions
Contains four exploit packages to root the user's device (three for 32-bit, one for 64-bit Android systems)
Gains root privileges to tamper with Android core system files
Injects into libdvm.so or libandroid_runtime.so processes depending on Android version
Disables Google's VerifyApps security scanner to install third-party apps without alerts
Attack Vector: Malicious updates to the Android app 'colourblock' on Google Play Store
Root exploits executed via trojan payload
Date of Discovery: Between 18 April and 15 May 2017 (malicious updates detected)
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of DVMap trojan code in colourblock app updates
Injection into libdvm.so or libandroid_runtime.so processes
